title: JetBrains
description: JetBrains' official brand palette spans black (#000000), greys (#7d7d7d, #cdcdcd), and a spectrum of lemon (#fcf84a), amber (#fdb60d), tangerine (#fc801d), reds and magentas (#fe2857, #dd1265, #ff318c, #ff45ed), purples (#af1df5, #6b57ff), blues (#087cfa, #07c3f2), and greens (#21d789, #3dea62). Hex, RGB, CMYK, and Pantone values are published on JetBrains' Brand Assets page.
